usedFor: Postman holds your API collections, and Google Sheets logs them when “New Collection” runs “Add New Row to Sheet”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Collection” in Postman, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Every new collection becomes a row, giving you one sheet that tracks what your team has created.

watchOut: “Updated Collection” fires on every edit, so one collection can add many rows to the sheet.
